processes.realtime_position_notice_broadcast: Trading manager emails the real-time group the open short or long MW position by hour and hub, with instructions on which book to buy or schedule under.
processes.deal_pma_correction_followup: Chasing and fixing missing or wrong deals and prior-month adjustments (PMA) in Enpower so revenue and cost are trued up before the P&L flash.
processes.realtime_desk_procedure_reminder: Manager broadcasts operating rules and reminders to the real-time desk (bidding, scheduling, call-ins, email routing) that staff must follow.
